{{Quote|I guess Mr. Borkus was actually telling the truth... for once.|Gregor|<ref name="Missing in Action" />}}
'''Borkus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Chef/Legends|cook]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]], where he owned and ran the diner [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]] in [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]].

==Biography==
[[File:BorkusThreatensGascon-AIM.png|thumb|left|250px|Borkus threatening Meebur Gascon with his chef's [[Knife/Legends|knife]]]]
When [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]] crash-landed on [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]], Borkus helped by providing accommodations and a job for him, albeit paying a lower wage than what he charged for the rent in order to keep the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] from ever leaving.<ref name="Missing in Action" />

When [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]] went into Borkus's diner for food and announced that he was from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Borkus forced him to leave, so [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]] led Gascon to the garbage cans out back to see if there was anything he could eat there.<ref name="Missing in Action" />

Gregor was taking out the trash when he discovered Gascon. Meebur knew at once he was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]], but Gregor did not believe him. Later, Gregor asked Borkus if he was a clone, and Borkus became very angry and told him to never say the word again.<ref name="Missing in Action" />

Later, Gregor and D-Squad broke into the diner at night, searching for Gregor's [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|clone armor]], when Borkus walked in with it. Borkus pointed Gregor's own [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System]] at him, and eventually the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] ended up on the floor, tied up thanks to the tow cables of [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]]. He went seemingly insane as he told them that they would never get off the planet and would be forced to work for him forever and burst out laughing.<ref name="Missing in Action" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Borkus.png|thumb|right|200px|Borkus]]
Borkus first appeared in "[[Missing in Action]]," the twelfth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, becoming the first and only Sullustan to appear in the show. Borkus was voiced by veteran ''Clone Wars'' actor [[Tom Kane]], who also provided the voice of the narrator and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="Missing in Action" />
